shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg -n \"calendar dialog|Calendar|dialog|translate\" src | head -120 && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p' && rg -n \"calendar_container\" src/test test __tests__ 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' src/calendar_container.tsx && sed -n '1680,1760p' src/index.tsx && rg -n \"CalendarContainer|role=\\\"dialog\\\"|translate=\" src/test src --glob '*test*' --glob '*.tsx'"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "react-datepicker Safari browser auto-translation calendar dialog translate attribute React reconciliation" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/test/calendar_container.test.tsx && sed -n '1290,1335p' src/calendar.tsx && rg -n 'translate=\"no\"|translate:' src test 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-datepicker-browser-translation.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Protect live datepicker UI from browser translation

Interactive calendar markup should opt out of browser page translation at its outer container. Browser translation can rewrite descendant text nodes while React owns the same DOM, which can corrupt reconciliation and break subsequent widget interactions; the standard "'`translate="no"` attribute keeps the live UI stable.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals
git status --short
git diff --check'
